title: Lean 4 Formalization of Busch's and Gleason's Theorems
description: AFM-facing final documentation release of the Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of finite-dimensional complex versions of Busch's and Gleason's representation theorems. Relative to v1.1.0-journal-audit, no Lean source file or theorem body is changed. This release freezes the cleaned publication-facing README and citation metadata used by the Annals of Formalized Mathematics article. The scientific theorem surface remains Gleason.busch, Gleason.busch_born_rule, Gleason.gleason, and Gleason.no_dispersion_free, with the same pinned Lean and Mathlib dependencies.
